Commercial Real Estate

Commercial property sales for investors and business owners in the region.

Commercial transactions require a different read than residential — income potential, zoning, traffic counts, and how a space compares to what else is available in the market. Danny applies the same investor’s eye to commercial property that he brings to land and residential deals.

Frequently Asked Questions

Commercial listings are evaluated case by case — retail, office, and small commercial buildings in southcentral Kansas. Reach out directly with the property type and Danny will tell you honestly whether it’s a fit.
Yes — investor clients get a straightforward read on income potential, condition, and realistic valuation, informed by Danny’s own investing background rather than just comparable sales.
Commercial valuation leans heavily on income potential, lease terms (if tenant-occupied), and comparable cap rates in the market, in addition to physical condition and location.
